run_f_gold: run the f_gold function to compute the sum of all elements up to the nth row in Pascal's triangle
test_f_gold: test the f_gold function with integer inputs like 4, 21, 31, 79, 38, 75, 36, 32, 23, 65
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function that uses bitwise shift to compute 2^n - 1 for Pascal's triangle row sums
